# DataVault.AI

> DataVault.AI is an enterprise software development agency specialising in custom AI, web, mobile, and cloud infrastructure. We build production-ready LLM integrations, machine learning systems, React/Next.js web applications, React Native mobile apps, and AWS/Azure/GCP cloud deployments for enterprise clients worldwide.

## Company

- [Homepage](https://datavalutai.com/): Full overview of services, portfolio, and company information
- [About / Why Us](https://datavalutai.com/#why-us): Why enterprise clients choose DataVault.AI — team expertise, process, and guarantees
- [Portfolio](https://datavalutai.com/#portfolio): Case studies and delivered enterprise projects
- [Testimonials](https://datavalutai.com/#testimonials): Client reviews and success stories
- [Contact](https://datavalutai.com/#contact): Get in touch for a free consultation

## Services

- [AI Development](https://datavalutai.com/services/ai-development): Custom LLM integration (GPT-4, Claude, Gemini), RAG systems, vector databases, computer vision, NLP, and ML model training. Enterprise AI consulting and strategy.
- [Web Development](https://datavalutai.com/services/web-development): Enterprise web applications built with React, Next.js, and Node.js. REST and GraphQL APIs, Progressive Web Apps, headless CMS integration, and TypeScript development.
- [Mobile Development](https://datavalutai.com/services/mobile-development): Native and cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android using React Native, Swift, and Kotlin. App Store Optimization and real-time sync.
- [Cloud Infrastructure & Hosting](https://datavalutai.com/services/web-hosting): Scalable cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, and GCP. Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and 24/7 infrastructure monitoring with 99.9% uptime SLA.

## Technology Stack

AI/ML: OpenAI GPT-4, Anthropic Claude, LangChain, Pinecone, Weaviate, TensorFlow, PyTorch, FastAPI
Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Progressive Web Apps
Backend: Node.js, Python, REST APIs, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB
Mobile: React Native, Swift (iOS), Kotlin (Android)
Cloud: AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform
